audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill, Zac, Zac, Skill, Skill, Zac, Zac. The packet chart reads Skill, Maokai, Maokai, Maokai, Skill, Maokai, Maokai, and all seven whys[] strings describe Maokai winning or holding those stages — whys[5] says 'holding the lane favored', whys[6] says 'your sustain edge and blob-denial carry'.
audit.why: Zac is immobile once Elastic Slingshot is spent, and a point-and-click root plus Sap Magic beats his blob sustain in short trades. A 56.52% win rate over 69 games supports a Maokai-favoured chart, not a Zac-favoured one.
audit.corrected: Skill, Maokai, Maokai, Maokai, Skill, Maokai, Maokai — the packet chart, which the prose already matches.

audit.why: Spikes are honest: Maokai at 2-3 and first item, Level 6 correctly called a wash because Nature's Grasp and Elastic Slingshot are both engage tools rather than duel-winners, and the late spike correctly names the passive reassembly as the thing that resets a won fight.

audit.whatIsWrong: Unstable Matter is never mentioned anywhere, and it is the ability that argues with your own build. Elastic Slingshot is tracked throughout with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: Unstable Matter is a 5-second, 350-range explosion dealing a percentage of your maximum health as MAGIC damage — so a Heartsteel-stacked Maokai hands it more damage, and magic resist rather than more HP is the answer. Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1, the longest punish window in his kit.
audit.corrected: Percent-max-HP magic damage written into dontsFull[1].d and the itemization line; the 21s cooldown into dosFull[0].d.
sources: brief enemyKit W text + cd 5 + percentHealth flag

audit.why: Zac's E carries a 'grounding' derived flag in the kit, and the missing-interactions file reportedly claims Elastic Slingshot shuts off Twisted Advance. Riot's own text says only that he attaches his arms and launches himself forward — no grounding. The Zac-side auditor reached the same conclusion and ignored it; I did too.
sources: brief enemyKit E text vs its grounding flag

edits.before: His engage. W-peel after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 — step up the moment it whiffs.

edits.after: Unstable Matter is percent-max-HP every 5s — raw HP feeds it.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Heartsteel  (the HP engine), then Thornmail / Spirit Visage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Heartsteel, then Spirit Visage — Unstable Matter is percent-max-HP magic damage, so MR beats more HP; boots Mercury's Treads. Anti-heal early: his blob pickups fight your grind.
